name: Better input
description: Coyote time, jump buffer, optional jump boost, hold-flight smoothing (ship + swing, gravity-flip aware), and a read-only Wave Consistency HUD — all in one. Addon for Subtick Inputs API.

coyote-enabled.name: Coyote Time
coyote-enabled.description: Jump pressed shortly after walking off an edge still registers.

coyote-window-ms.name: Coyote Window (ms)
coyote-window-ms.description: How many ms after leaving the ground a jump input is still accepted.

buffer-enabled.name: Jump Buffer
buffer-enabled.description: Jump pressed slightly before landing still fires when you touch the ground.

buffer-window-ms.name: Buffer Window (ms)
buffer-window-ms.description: How many ms before landing a buffered jump press is accepted.

jump-boost-enabled.name: Jump Boost
jump-boost-enabled.description: Adds a small extra push on top of every jump. Not a 'fix' for anything — Subtick Inputs' slightly lower jump height on late-tick clicks is correct physics, not a bug. This is an optional buff for players who want jumps to feel a bit stronger anyway.

jump-boost-amount.name: Boost Amount (GD velocity units)
jump-boost-amount.description: Flat extra velocity added on a real jump, not a percentage. Default 0.3 ≈ barely noticeable. Try 0.5-1.0 if you want it more obvious. Values above ~2 will feel like a real height increase, not a tweak.

debounce-enabled.name: Re-grant Debounce
debounce-enabled.description: Minimum gap between two forgiveness grants to prevent spam-clicking from chaining coyote + buffer into a double trigger.

debounce-ms.name: Debounce Gap (ms)
debounce-ms.description: Minimum ms between two forgiveness grants for the same player.

straight-fly-enabled.name: Straight Fly (Ship)
straight-fly-enabled.description: Smooths ship Y-velocity between physics ticks to reduce jitter while holding the button. Re-snaps instantly (does not blend) across gamemode changes or gravity flips, so it won't drag a post-flip ship toward its pre-flip feel. Does not affect trajectory or input timing.

smooth-swing-enabled.name: Smooth Swing
smooth-swing-enabled.description: Same jitter-smoothing as Straight Fly, applied to swing instead of ship. Shares the Smoothing Factor / Tap Grace Window settings below.

straight-fly-smoothing.name: Smoothing Factor
straight-fly-smoothing.description: 0 = no smoothing (vanilla), higher = smoother but more lag. Keep at or below 0.5. Shared by Straight Fly and Smooth Swing.

straight-fly-grace-ms.name: Tap Grace Window (ms)
straight-fly-grace-ms.description: How long after releasing the button the smoothed state is kept (for rhythm tap-patterns). Shared by Straight Fly and Smooth Swing.

robot-boost-coyote-enabled.name: Robot Boost Coyote
robot-boost-coyote-enabled.description: Widens the coyote window while a robot is mid-boost off a pad (gravity is temporarily suppressed for it, so the normal window can feel too strict there).

robot-boost-coyote-multiplier.name: Robot Boost Coyote Multiplier
robot-boost-coyote-multiplier.description: Coyote window is multiplied by this while the robot-boost condition holds.

warn-small-windows.name: Warn About Unresolvable Windows
warn-small-windows.description: Logs a warning in the console (does not change gameplay) if a coyote/buffer window is set narrower than what Subtick Inputs API's Input Hz setting can actually resolve.

warn-gravity-flip-anomaly.name: Warn On Ship Gravity-Flip Anomaly
warn-gravity-flip-anomaly.description: Diagnostic only, changes no physics. Logs a warning when a ship gravity portal/orb flip likely landed on Subtick Inputs API's anomalous gravity-coefficient branch for that tick (the moment that can feel like the ship suddenly got 'heavier'). Useful for confirming the issue is happening on a level before reporting it upstream.

wave-hud-enabled.name: Wave Consistency HUD
wave-hud-enabled.description: Read-only overlay showing how consistent your wave click timing is, in ms. Never modifies input, physics, or the input queue — display only.

wave-hud-target-mode.name: Target Interval Mode
wave-hud-target-mode.description: How the 'ideal' click interval is determined.

wave-hud-manual-target-ms.name: Manual Target (ms)
wave-hud-manual-target-ms.description: Used only if Target Interval Mode = manual.

wave-hud-history-size.name: History Size
wave-hud-history-size.description: How many recent clicks to keep for rolling average / display.

wave-hud-bad-threshold-ms.name: Bad Threshold (ms)
wave-hud-bad-threshold-ms.description: Above this deviation = shown red (between = yellow).

wave-hud-scale.name: HUD Scale
wave-hud-scale.description: Size of the wave consistency overlay.
